'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 Justin Desai LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' (y2-y1)/(x2-x1)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
